# PR Description

## Summary

Describe the change in 1–2 clear sentences.

## Why

Explain why this change is needed.
Mention the problem, limitation, bug, operational risk, customer impact, or developer experience issue this PR addresses.

## Behavior Before

Describe the previous behavior before this PR.
Focus on observable behavior, not implementation details.

## Behavior After

Describe the new behavior after this PR.
Make clear what changes for users, systems, deployment flow, logs, validation, or callers.

## Validation

Describe how the change was validated.
Include tests, manual checks, local runs, deployment validation, Kusto/log queries, or explain why validation is not applicable.

## Risk / Rollback

Describe the risk level and rollback plan.
Mention compatibility concerns, feature flags, config switches, or revert strategy if relevant.

## Reviewer Focus

Tell reviewers what parts deserve attention.
For example: behavior change, edge cases, schema changes, deployment impact, or test coverage.

## Related Links

Add related work items, design docs, incidents, dashboards, previous PRs, or discussions.
